correctness.rationale: The four ODEs restrict invariantly to a two-variable segregated plane; the stationary sum has an exact analytic root s(d). An odd analytic contrast equation has a simple positive derivative in steepness and a strictly negative cubic coefficient, giving two local patterned roots on the supercritical side. Two remaining Jacobian eigenvalues are -1 and +(a-1)/(a+1) at onset, proving a persistent positive unstable eigenvalue. The exact coefficients and independent numerical Jacobians were checked from the included program; the theorem does not infer infinite claims from finite tests.

value.rationale: The exact threshold identifies when infinitely small segregated stationary states appear under sigmoidal competition-avoidance mobility. The nontrivial cubic coefficient and exact persistent positive eigenvalue rigorously separate pattern onset from stable ecological coexistence, a natural distinction for interpreting the source’s coexistence diagrams; the symmetric specialization is the canonical exchange-symmetry boundary, not an arbitrary parameter choice.
